_comment: The wolf blows a house down. The wind-up is the gag: he leans BACK over four stepped beats, holds at the top, then snaps forward. Stepped `parts` transforms rather than a pose, because the rigs' shipped `lean` is a conversational 4-degree tilt — casting on `poses:[lean, idle]` succeeded on `idle` and then played a `lean` nobody could see, so the house fell down by itself while the wolf stood there. Amplitude is what makes an action read; a correct gag with 4 degrees of movement is an invisible one. Timed for 12fps: every step is 2+ frames.
triggers: takes a deep breath and blows

structure._comment: Ranked by how well each name fits the location: a brick set picks the brick house, which then CANNOT collapse, and the gag refuses rather than substituting a thatched cottage for it.
structure._placeScale_comment: A cottage, not a shed. At the old 0.72 default the house came out the same height as the pig standing next to it, which is why the film read as 'a pig beside a box'. COUPLED to the occupant's `at.dy` below: the window sits at prop-local y 0.335-0.54, so its height above ground is 0.02 + 0.335 x placeScale. Change one, recompute the other.

occupant._comment: Whoever is sheltering inside, put in the WINDOW so the audience can see who this is happening to. Optional: the house still comes down with nobody home. dy 0.43 stands them on the floor INSIDE — head and shoulders in the opening, body hidden behind the wall below the sill, which is the classic face-at-the-window. Because the renderer draws upstage first, a higher y is also what puts them BEHIND the wall rather than in front of it. Recompute this if placeScale changes.

beats._comment: the wind-up begins — stepped, because part transforms SNAP and stepping is how limited animation moves
the inhale, eased — whole-actor moves TWEEN where parts do not
the breath drawn in, under the hold
THE BLOW — 36 degrees of swing in one frame, which is the whole point
the lurch into the blow. An explicit duration, because a move without one spreads over the whole rest of the shot and a snap becomes a slow drift.
NO duration: a duration expires the clip and the house pops back intact

out of the wreckage. The occupant was staged at WINDOW height, so when the house flattened they stayed floating in mid-air above the heap. scaleBy 2.0 against their 0.30 window mark returns them to roughly full size on the ground.
